_comment: Named lenses for the parcel locker example. Presentation, not language: a saved filter on the diagram, feeding no analysis. Committed, unlike the other two sidecars, because named lenses are worth sharing while layout coordinates and composer hints are per-developer. Deleting this file loses saved lenses and nothing else. See ../../docs/design.md section 4.2.

Handover._why: The delivery process end to end, with the locker estate behind a port: what a parcel's journey touches, and nothing about how a door works.

Estate._why: The hardware and what drives it. Everything in the delivery package is aggregated into ports, which is what a perimeter view of the lockers looks like.

PiiFlow._why: Where personal data goes. Only works because labels propagate: @pii is declared on two values in parcel.common, and it reaches every record, message and pipe that carries them.

Perimeter._why: Where the system ends. `label:external` selects annotations as well as declared labels, which is the only reason this selector can work at all: `label external` is an error to declare.

Lossy._why: The one pipe that may lose a message, and the two things on either side of it. Nothing may depend on it for progress.
